register_artifact.title: Register an artifact for push
register_artifact.description: Registers a monitor artifact so that it may later be pushed to a device. The station enforces the design's rule even in the stub: registration is refused without the id of an evaluate report whose verdict is pass. This is an operator's action; the harness requests approval before the call reaches the station.

diagnostic_load_model.title: Push a registered artifact to a device
diagnostic_load_model.description: Pushes a registered artifact to a device; the device validates the sha256 and the contract on its side. Refused for a sha256 the station has not registered. An operator's action, approved before it is called.

journal_rows.title: Read the journal of operating points
journal_rows.description: Returns rows of the journal of stable operating points, in the shape the fit job reads (duty_percent, current_amps), optionally filtered by device and time. On the stub it stays empty until a device sends operating_point notifications. Reading is free.
